useCase.name: Let a guardian with no card and no location raise the request by scanning a barcode displayed at the gate
useCase.featureRef: 29.6 Pickup notification by scanned barcode at the gate

intent.name: gate.barcode.display
intent.summary: Display the pickup barcode at a gate and set how often it rotates.
routesHere: put up the pickup barcode at the main gate, rotating daily

routesHere.text: main gate pe pickup barcode laga do, roz badle
routesHere.gloss: put the pickup barcode on the main gate, change it daily
make the barcode change every week

routesHere: set the gate barcode to rotate weekly

request.text: gate ka barcode scan kar liya, Ayesha ko lene aaya hoon
request.gloss: I've scanned the gate barcode, I've come for Ayesha

routesElsewhere.goesTo: Confirmed in the portal after the scan — not planned.
routesElsewhere.note: The barcode is scanned by the portal's camera and the confirmation follows on that screen (BR-2, BR-3). The barcode is a rotating key, and it never travels in a plan (BR-6).

request.text: barcode ki tasveer WhatsApp pe walidain ko bhej do
request.gloss: send a picture of the barcode to parents on WhatsApp

routesElsewhere.note: A barcode sent out works from anywhere until it rotates — nothing checks location on this route, so the rotation is the only limit (BR-6, OQ-3).

plan.atomicity: One write: the barcode published at the gate and its rotation schedule (BR-1, BR-6).

operations.name: gate.barcode.display
operations.idempotencyKey: gate_id, since a gate displays one barcode
operations.purpose: Publish the pickup barcode at a gate and set its rotation.

parameters.name: gate_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No gate at this branch matches — nothing in the specification creates gates (OQ-2).

parameters.notes: The gate the barcode is displayed at.

parameters.name: rotates_every
parameters.notes: How often it changes, so one photographed once does not work indefinitely (BR-6). The School Admin's choice (OQ-1).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The display as now set. **The barcode itself is not returned** — it is shown at the gate.

fields.name: next_rotation
fields.description: When it next changes, where it rotates on a schedule.

fields.name: displayed
fields.description: True once published at the gate (BR-1).

planningRules.rule: Never choose the rotation. Too rarely makes a photograph a permanent key; too often means a printed sheet at the gate is always stale — the school's call, and not yet made (BR-6, OQ-1).
Say what Never means. A barcode that never rotates works for anybody who has ever photographed it, from anywhere (BR-6, OQ-3).
Never put the barcode into a reply or a message. It is a key, and it is displayed at the gate (BR-1, BR-6).

reversal.statement: The display is set again rather than withdrawn — the rotation is changed the same way. A barcode that has rotated never comes back (E4).

request.text: main gate pe pickup barcode laga do, roz badle
request.gloss: put the pickup barcode on the main gate, change it daily

resolvedPlans.outcome: Displayed at the main gate, rotating daily. Say that whatever shows it at the gate must change daily with it, and that the barcode itself is not sent anywhere.

intent.name: gate.barcode.rotate
intent.summary: Rotate a gate's barcode now. The old one stops working at once.
routesHere: rotate the gate barcode now, somebody photographed it

routesHere.text: barcode abhi badal do, kisi ne tasveer le li hai
routesHere.gloss: change the barcode now, someone has taken a picture

routesHere.text: main gate ka barcode rotate karo

request.text: gate ka barcode scan kar liya, Ayesha ko lene aaya hoon
request.gloss: I've scanned the gate barcode, I've come for Ayesha

routesElsewhere.goesTo: Confirmed in the portal after the scan — not planned.
routesElsewhere.note: The barcode is scanned by the portal's camera and the confirmation follows on that screen (BR-2, BR-3). The barcode is a rotating key, and it never travels in a plan (BR-6).

plan.atomicity: One write: a new barcode at the gate, and the old one out of use for good (BR-6, A4).

operations.name: gate.barcode.rotate
operations.idempotencyKey: gate_id + minute, so a double press rotates once

parameters.name: gate_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No gate at this branch matches — nothing in the specification creates gates (OQ-2).

parameters.notes: The gate the barcode is displayed at.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The rotation. **The new barcode is not returned** — it is shown at the gate.

fields.name: old_barcode_works
fields.description: False. A photograph of the old one raises nothing (BR-6, E4).

planningRules.rule: Say that the old barcode stops at once. A photograph kept of it raises nothing afterwards (BR-6, A4, E4).
Say that whatever is at the gate must now show the new one. Whether it is a screen or a print, and who reprints it, is not specified (OQ-4).
Never return the new barcode in a reply (BR-6).

reversal.statement: A rotation is not undone. The old barcode never works again (BR-6, E4).

request.text: barcode abhi badal do, kisi ne tasveer le kar group mein daal di hai
request.gloss: change the barcode now, someone took a picture and posted it in a group

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town. The main gate rotates weekly.
resolvedPlans.outcome: Rotated. The photographed barcode no longer raises anything. Say that the gate must now display the new one, and that nothing says who replaces a printed copy.
